rationale: render-skia-dawn: gpu_surface.hpp and gpu_render_time.hpp gain an `#if defined(PULP_GPU_RUNTIME)` branch that includes <gpu_runtime/...> and forwards each name to gpu-runtime's identical declaration; their original text stays unchanged under `#else`. retained-ui-kernel: window_host.hpp, under the same guard, takes GpuSurface from pulp/platform/gpu_fwd.hpp, and keeps its original declarations unchanged under `#else`. The three paths are edited here on the owner unfreeze recorded in .github/vellum-export-receipt/owner-unfreezes.json, because a class declaration of GpuSurface cannot coexist with the gpu-runtime alias and Vellum's mirror/ is read-only. vellum_inherits is true: the next re-export carries these bytes, and since Vellum never defines PULP_GPU_RUNTIME for mirrored sources, the `#else` text it compiles is the text it has today. Hazard: Vellum must never define PULP_GPU_RUNTIME for mirrored sources while it builds the mirror's own device layer, or the mirrored headers would forward to gpu-runtime's types without the matching implementation.
